title: Superuser bypasses Row-Level Security
what: A PostgreSQL superuser is exempt from row-level security. Connect as postgres and every policy silently does nothing.
why_invisible: No error, no warning. Policies simply do not apply, so every access-control test passes for the wrong reason.
detection: The application role is NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS, verified rolsuper=f and rolbypassrls=f, and the connection string is fixed in configuration.
evidence: Verified directly against the running database before any security measurement was taken.
